summary: Enforce conditional architecture classification and conformance gates
description: Add deterministic minimum-impact classification, claim preflight, architecture critic findings, conformance recording, waiver lifecycle, and finish gates. Material changes require applicable context/evidence; foundational or explicit irreversible/security/data-boundary decisions require human approval evidence.
acceptance: Hard triggers can raise architecture impact but automated classification cannot lower an explicit or deterministic minimum.
Claim fails closed for material/foundational tasks with missing briefs or decisions while none/local tasks retain the normal workflow.
Finish requires conformance evidence and any declared human gate; waivers require actor, reason, accepted risk, and future expiry.
Semantic critic reports unresolved decisions, stale waivers, missing quality-attribute evidence, and implicit boundary changes.
verification: uv run --no-project --with pytest --with jsonschema pytest tests/test_architecture.py -q
